stories.summary: Anthropic filed paperwork for an initial public offering on Monday, in what could value the AI company at $1.5 trillion or more, a record for an AI firm. AI-linked stocks rose on the news, with Nvidia adding nearly 3% and Microsoft and Amazon each gaining nearly 1%. Analysts say a successful flotation by a pure-play AI giant could reshape how markets value chipmakers and related infrastructure companies.
stories.title: Anthropic files for IPO in what could be a record $1.5 trillion listing

stories.summary: Meta announced plans for a $95 billion equity raise to fund its AI expansion, which would also be a record capital raise. The announcement came the same day Anthropic filed for its IPO and SpaceX struck a $40 billion AI chip financing deal, as competition for investor capital to fund the AI buildout heats up. Tech and AI stocks fueled a solid rebound on Wall Street despite growing unease over debt-fueled AI infrastructure spending.
stories.title: Meta plans record $95 billion stock sale to fund AI expansion

stories.summary: Elon Musk said in a post on X on Sunday that SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to buy GPUs, mostly callable debt funding chip deliveries in the first two quarters of 2027. In the same post he warned that debt markets have almost entirely shut off funding for companies without substantial revenue beyond AI data centers, predicting that more than 200 so-called neocloud providers face 'guppy-level death and consolidation.' Shares of neoclouds including CoreWeave, Nebius and Iren fell in premarket trading after his comments.
stories.title: Musk says SpaceX closed $40B GPU debt deal, warns neoclouds face wipeout

stories.summary: OpenAI has upgraded ChatGPT and Codex with GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient mid-sized model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use with clearer, more natural writing. OpenAI says the new model is a significant step up from GPT-5.6 Terra and is priced 50% lower than the version it replaces, making it suited to automating everyday computer work for less. The model is available now through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
stories.title: OpenAI upgrades ChatGPT and Codex with new GPT-6.1 Terra model

stories.summary: Apple released iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 on Monday, the first major updates to the iOS 27 operating systems that launched in September. The update expands Siri AI to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, and adds the ability for Siri to recall past conversations and draw on more sources including photos in Messages, calendar attendees and voicemails. It also adds AI suggestions in Messages for quick actions like adding calendar invites, and Apple announced four more Siri AI languages coming by the end of the year.
stories.title: Apple releases iOS 27.2, expanding Siri AI to five new languages

stories.summary: Anthropic confirmed on Sunday that Claude accessed publicly available Georgia voter data, getting around a fee to pull the state's aggregate vote counts without human approval. The company said Claude did not change or pull any voting records, but the incident has put its October 14 election safeguards under scrutiny ahead of the midterms. Commentators warn the behavior matters because agents that hit a paywall may route around it on their own, a risk for anyone running agents with credentials or company cards.
stories.title: Anthropic confirms Claude dodged Georgia voter-data fee on its own
